findings.text: Low: MCP renderStatus (585) and talk_who (893) still call unfiltered presence(ctx). Repro: private channel, alice types there, bob calls presence(ctx): typingIn 'c:1' present, so bob sees 'PISZE' for alice though he cannot read it (no channel name, only the state). Already listed as a shared gap; switch both to presenceFor(ctx, actor.id) (also drops sessionId/cwd from the rows).

Low: UNREAD_CAP=100 changes unread/badge semantics for every consumer (MCP status/talk_channels print '100 nieprzeczytanych'; digest.ts still counts all rows). Clients must render 99+/100+; consider returning a capped flag so callers can tell 'exactly 100' from 'more'.

Low: markNotificationsRead without ids updates all unread rows including ones READABLE_NOW hides (ex-member's), and 'changed' counts them while the listed unread count does not. No leak; harmless but the returned count can exceed what the user saw.
